name: Axle Connect
description:
Axle Connect brings your work into Claude. Ask questions, stay informed, and keep your day moving.

Available to members of Axle’s private business community. Sign in with your Axle account. Your existing permissions apply.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Axle Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Axle Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.axlefoundation.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Axle Connect MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Axle Connect lists 30 MCP tools, including create_lead, create_work_request, dispatch_ticket, get_assigned_location_sitrep, get_hours_statement, get_job_detail, get_my_certifications, get_my_context, get_my_equipment, get_my_jobs, get_my_jobsites, and get_my_leads.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Axle Connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Axle Connect in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Axle Connect MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Axle Connect requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Axle Connect is developed by Axle Field Management. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
